Found 54 papers for CFTR, of 1962 available.⁠1–20

Sodium 4-phenylbutyrate downregulation of Hsc70 and its implications for ΔF508-CFTR intracellular trafficking are also covered.⁠7

DOMAIN FUNCTION AND PROTEIN INTERACTIONS

CFTR functional expression at the apical membrane, accessory-protein-potentiated channel activity, and AMP-activated protein kinase-mediated inhibition are additionally reported.⁠10, 15, 11

MUTATION ANALYSIS AND GENOTYPE–PHENOTYPE STUDIES

A series of mutation-focused reports describe specific CFTR variants—D579G homozygosity with pancreatic sufficiency, D513G in a French CBAVD patient, the S1235R mutation, and the 5T allele—and six novel mutations identified in congenital bilateral aplasia of vas deferens patients.⁠2 +4

Additional topics include a regulatory DNase I hypersensitive site upstream of the CFTR gene, exon 9 skipping mediated by splicing factors, worldwide genetic analysis of the CFTR region, neonatal screening outcomes, and CFTR mutation prevalence in hypertrypsinaemia.⁠4 +4
